promesa.tagline: Your AI agent, measured against the plan you wrote before building it.
promesa.intro: planlang turns the plan of an AI-agent project into a verifiable contract: what the agent decides, what can go wrong, what is taken for granted and how success is measured. With that contract the agent is built, run on hundreds of cases whose answer is known, and the gap between what was planned and what happened is published, failures included, in a static showcase that calls no model.
promesa.para_quien: For whoever plans, builds or approves AI agents and today judges them by reading traces and running loose evaluations, without having written down first what they were meant to do. Whoever decides gets a verdict in plain words; whoever builds gets the rule, the signal and the case behind every figure.

titular: An AI agent's plan is written down as a contract before it is built, and a verifier with no AI publishes, case by case, the gap between what was planned and what happened, with its failures in plain sight and its thresholds ready to move.

pasos.texto: Drafts the plan and flags contradictions
Validates the plan, with no AI
You fill in what is missing
You approve the plan and it is sealed
Generates cases with a known answer
Decides each case according to the plan
Does the plan require a person?

anotaciones.texto: Asks in order what the sector template requires, with an example in each question; it never approves for you.
Rejects, with the exact reason, criteria without a rule, thresholds without a signal and serious risks without mitigation.
With the Claude Code subscription, 20 cases at a time and with pauses; if the run is cut off, it resumes without repeating any.
In the demos, that person is simulated with the case's known answer, and every screen says so.
With no model at all: the same plan and the same traces always give the same report, in Spanish and English.
Recomputed in the browser over the real decisions; nobody calls the model again.

limites: It is a simulation: it handles no real cases and decides on no one; the demos' human decisions were simulated with the known answer.
The interviewer and the runs live in the terminal; the site shows their results, already computed and verified.
It measures what the plan declared: what the plan did not foresee appears as an unforeseen gap, not as a verdict.
The playground recomputes over what the agent already did; outside the observed range, the result is marked “not observed”.
nunca: Uses real data: every case, member, physician, applicant and watchlist is synthetic.
Lets a model decide whether the agent got it right.
Issues a full denial or a rejection without a person reviewing it.
Calls a model to validate the plan, measure the gap, recompute thresholds or draw the agent.
